summary: Rocky Mountain Power (www.rockymountainpower.net, Electric utility, Active) shows a functional site (HTTP 200, 0/50 broken links, claimed profile) but Foundational digital maturity (33/100 band). Deterministic audit (confidence 88) flags content hierarchy as main issue: Homepage H1 count: 13 and Meta description length: 0 characters, plus Image alt-text coverage: 46% and Structured data: not found. Useful to address but limited complexity - opportunity score 62 suggests Review rather than immediate Pursue.

topOpportunities.title: Fix content hierarchy - reduce 13 H1s to one primary heading
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage H1 count: 13 - deterministic finding: The homepage does not use one clear primary heading.
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Multiple H1s dilute topical focus and screen-reader navigation. A single clear H1 may improve SEO clarity (current SEO 62/100) and accessibility without redesign.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Consolidate to a single H1 that states the core offer for residential/business customers in Utah, convert remaining 12 H1s to H2/H3 in logical order. Validate on https://www.rockymountainpower.net/ and key templates like /my-account/payments/bill-payment-assistance.html (H1 count: 5) and /my-account/energy-usage/meter-upgrade.html (H1 count: 9).

topOpportunities.title: Add meta description and canonical tag to homepage
topOpportunities.evidence: Meta description length: 0 characters - deterministic finding: The homepage description is missing or too brief to explain the offer clearly.
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Missing description and canonical weakens search snippet control and duplicate handling. Small metadata lift that could aid the 62/100 SEO score.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Write a 140-160 character meta description for homepage (title: Rocky Mountain Power) and add missing Canonical URL: not found. Prioritize homepage and top pay/account pages: /my-account/payments/pay-in-person.html, /my-account/payments/bill-payment-assistance.html.

topOpportunities.title: Raise alt-text coverage from 46% to improve accessibility
topOpportunities.evidence: Image alt-text coverage: 46% across 28 images on homepage - measured accessibility 73/100
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: 46% coverage contributes to accessibility 73/100 (Fair mobileQuality) and impacts screen-reader users at a utility serving the public.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Audit 28 homepage images, add descriptive alt text where informative and empty alt where decorative. Start with homepage then roll to high-image pages. Recheck altCoverage target >90%.

topOpportunities.title: Implement structured data (Organization/LocalBusiness)
topOpportunities.evidence: JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0 and Structured data: not found
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Zero schema blocks means missed opportunity for richer search results; foundational technical SEO work that complements GA4 already detected.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add Organization and LocalBusiness/Energy utility JSON-LD (name, address: 1407 W North Temple St, Salt Lake City, UT 84116, website: www.rockymountainpower.net) to homepage. Add FAQ or Service schema to assistance pages if applicable.
